image_description: A top-down view of a white bowl containing three scoops of ice cream. The central scoop is white with pink/purple swirls and dark specks, while the two side scoops appear to be vanilla or light caramel with some browning/melting. The ice cream shows signs of melting into a liquid pool at the bottom of the bowl. A spoon rests in the bowl on the right side. The background includes a wooden surface and a patterned napkin or cloth on the left.

To rigorously analyze the gibberish text on the bowl rim, determining if it is completely nonsensical or just distorted real text.
To check for structural integrity of the rigid objects (bowl/spoon) and ensure no melting/fusion artifacts exist between the utensil and the container.

focus_areas: Legibility and semantic validity of the text on the bowl rim.
Physical plausibility of the melting dynamics (liquid viscosity and flow).
Boundary sharpness between the spoon, the bowl, and the background.
Texture consistency of the ice cream scoops vs. the melted liquid.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the bowl. In real images, branding is usually legible even if curved. In AI images, it often degrades into pseudo-text. Also, verify if the 'melting' looks physically accurate (viscosity) or if it looks like smudged paint. Check the spoon's reflection and shadow for consistency with the lighting source.
